definitions.explanation: A vehicle used for transporting goods and cargo, whether a railway freight car or a road vehicle.

examples.japanese: {貨物車|かもつしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通過|つうか}した→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧。
{貨物車|かもつしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are roads where freight vehicles are restricted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{込|こ}み→引き込む：05736_hikikomu⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{貨物車|かもつしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何両|なんりょう}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{留置|りゅうち}⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Several old freight cars were parked on the siding at the station.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{貨物|かもつ}→貨物：00165_kamotsu⟧ (freight, cargo) and ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle, car). Can refer to either a railway freight car or a road vehicle used for hauling goods.

In the railway context, {貨物車|かもつしゃ} specifically refers to individual freight cars as distinct from ⟦{貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}→貨物列車：16297_kamotsuressha⟧ (freight train), which is the entire train. On roads, it refers to trucks and other cargo-carrying vehicles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貨物車|かもつしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧: freight vehicle traffic
- {貨物車|かもつしゃ}⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧: freight vehicles only
- {有蓋|ゆうがい}{貨物車|かもつしゃ}: covered freight car (railway)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}→貨物列車：16297_kamotsuressha⟧: freight train — the entire train, not individual cars
- ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧: truck — the common word for a cargo truck on the road
- {貨車|かしゃ}: freight car — shortened form, used mainly for railway cars
